scope: Read-only independent audit of the four SFC shoulder controls and preservation of the preceding console-shell repair.
model: ../SFC_日版双手柄_线材肩键修正版.bbmodel

pressTest.method: For each shoulder, sample a 121-by-61 XZ grid across the cap region, retain points inside the union of the three rotated top-cap rectangles, then compare the translated cap top against fixed-shell OBB coverage at each retained point. Independently inspect the low-angle rest and pressed previews.
pressTest.qualification: This is a modelling/preview clearance check only. It does not configure or verify in-game input binding or animation playback.

visualReview.finding: The shoulder controls now follow the rear contour with joined, substantial sidewalls instead of detached narrow strips. The low-angle pressed preview preserves the complete cap and label; no fixed socket face covers the cap or splits it into fragments. Visible vertical changes in tone at the three segments are the intended faceted curve, not gaps.
visualReview.initialIssueResolved: The first socket height of raw 1.207 would have covered the cap after a -0.035 final press. The audited model lowers that fixed socket to raw 1.17.
